notes: Reviewed: hath been showed is kept whole on הָיָה — a bare copula in its place (grace hath been from Jehovah) says what the existential says, so the verb is read as the ASV's rendering of הָיָה rather than a supplied event (rules 20, 21); the competing reading marking showed added is named in the unit note. a remnant to escape heads on escape under rule 31.
